catalog_typed_values.name: catalog_typed_values
catalog_typed_values.value: (`catalog_facts`.`region_id` IS NULL OR `catalog_facts`.`kind` = 'city') AND (`catalog_facts`.`cargo_unit_mass_kg` IS NULL OR (`catalog_facts`.`kind` = 'cargo' AND `catalog_facts`.`cargo_unit_mass_kg` >= 0)) AND (`catalog_facts`.`adr_category_id` IS NULL OR `catalog_facts`.`kind` = 'cargo') AND ((`catalog_facts`.`trailer_body_type_id` IS NULL AND `catalog_facts`.`trailer_chain_type_id` IS NULL) OR `catalog_facts`.`kind` = 'trailer_type')

trip_credit_shape.name: trip_credit_shape
trip_credit_shape.value: `trip_contributions`.`credited` = 0 OR (`trip_contributions`.`accepted` = 1 AND `trip_contributions`.`alias_of` IS NULL AND `trip_contributions`.`assignment_id` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_contributions`.`rule_version_id` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_contributions`.`attribution_at` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_contributions`.`actual_distance_m` > 0)

trip_trailer_shape.name: trip_trailer_shape
trip_trailer_shape.value: (`trip_fact_trailers`.`entity_id` IS NULL AND `trip_fact_trailers`.`catalog_fact_id` IS NULL AND `trip_fact_trailers`.`catalog_revision_id` IS NULL AND `trip_fact_trailers`.`source_field` IS NULL AND `trip_fact_trailers`.`unknown_reason` IS NOT NULL) OR (`trip_fact_trailers`.`entity_id` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_fact_trailers`.`catalog_fact_id` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_fact_trailers`.`catalog_revision_id` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_fact_trailers`.`source_field` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_fact_trailers`.`unknown_reason` IS NULL)

trip_fact_provenance_shape.name: trip_fact_provenance_shape
trip_fact_provenance_shape.value: (`trip_facts`.`kind` = 'source' AND `trip_facts`.`message_id` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_facts`.`base_fact_id` IS NULL AND `trip_facts`.`resolution_revision_id` IS NULL AND `trip_facts`.`derived_source_message_id` IS NULL) OR (`trip_facts`.`kind` = 'derived' AND `trip_facts`.`message_id` IS NULL AND `trip_facts`.`base_fact_id` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_facts`.`resolution_revision_id` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_facts`.`derived_source_message_id` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_facts`.`base_fact_id` <> `trip_facts`.`id`)

trip_fact_origin_shape.name: trip_fact_origin_shape
trip_fact_origin_shape.value: (`trip_facts`.`origin_entity_id` IS NULL AND `trip_facts`.`origin_fact_id` IS NULL AND `trip_facts`.`origin_catalog_revision_id` IS NULL) OR (`trip_facts`.`origin_entity_id` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_facts`.`origin_fact_id` IS NOT NULL AND ((`trip_facts`.`catalog_revision_id` IS NOT NULL AND (`trip_facts`.`origin_catalog_revision_id` IS NULL OR `trip_facts`.`origin_catalog_revision_id` = `trip_facts`.`catalog_revision_id`)) OR (`trip_facts`.`catalog_revision_id` IS NULL AND `trip_facts`.`origin_catalog_revision_id` IS NOT NULL)))

trip_fact_destination_shape.name: trip_fact_destination_shape
trip_fact_destination_shape.value: (`trip_facts`.`destination_entity_id` IS NULL AND `trip_facts`.`destination_fact_id` IS NULL AND `trip_facts`.`destination_catalog_revision_id` IS NULL) OR (`trip_facts`.`destination_entity_id` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_facts`.`destination_fact_id` IS NOT NULL AND ((`trip_facts`.`catalog_revision_id` IS NOT NULL AND (`trip_facts`.`destination_catalog_revision_id` IS NULL OR `trip_facts`.`destination_catalog_revision_id` = `trip_facts`.`catalog_revision_id`)) OR (`trip_facts`.`catalog_revision_id` IS NULL AND `trip_facts`.`destination_catalog_revision_id` IS NOT NULL)))

trip_fact_cargo_shape.name: trip_fact_cargo_shape
trip_fact_cargo_shape.value: (`trip_facts`.`cargo_entity_id` IS NULL AND `trip_facts`.`cargo_fact_id` IS NULL AND `trip_facts`.`cargo_catalog_revision_id` IS NULL) OR (`trip_facts`.`cargo_entity_id` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_facts`.`cargo_fact_id` IS NOT NULL AND ((`trip_facts`.`catalog_revision_id` IS NOT NULL AND (`trip_facts`.`cargo_catalog_revision_id` IS NULL OR `trip_facts`.`cargo_catalog_revision_id` = `trip_facts`.`catalog_revision_id`)) OR (`trip_facts`.`catalog_revision_id` IS NULL AND `trip_facts`.`cargo_catalog_revision_id` IS NOT NULL)))

trip_fact_adr_shape.name: trip_fact_adr_shape
trip_fact_adr_shape.value: (`trip_facts`.`adr_entity_id` IS NULL AND `trip_facts`.`adr_fact_id` IS NULL AND `trip_facts`.`adr_catalog_revision_id` IS NULL) OR (`trip_facts`.`adr_entity_id` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_facts`.`adr_fact_id` IS NOT NULL AND ((`trip_facts`.`catalog_revision_id` IS NOT NULL AND (`trip_facts`.`adr_catalog_revision_id` IS NULL OR `trip_facts`.`adr_catalog_revision_id` = `trip_facts`.`catalog_revision_id`)) OR (`trip_facts`.`catalog_revision_id` IS NULL AND `trip_facts`.`adr_catalog_revision_id` IS NOT NULL)))

trip_fact_start_supported.name: trip_fact_start_supported
trip_fact_start_supported.value: `trip_facts`.`start_verified` = 0 OR ((`trip_facts`.`start_basis` = 'event' OR (`trip_facts`.`kind` = 'derived' AND `trip_facts`.`start_basis` = 'staff-resolution')) AND `trip_facts`.`start_utc` IS NOT NULL)

trip_fact_end_supported.name: trip_fact_end_supported
trip_fact_end_supported.value: `trip_facts`.`end_verified` = 0 OR ((`trip_facts`.`end_basis` = 'event' OR (`trip_facts`.`kind` = 'derived' AND `trip_facts`.`end_basis` = 'staff-resolution')) AND `trip_facts`.`end_utc` IS NOT NULL)

trip_fact_quantities.name: trip_fact_quantities
trip_fact_quantities.value: (`trip_facts`.`cargo_mass_kg` IS NULL OR `trip_facts`.`cargo_mass_kg` >= 0) AND (`trip_facts`.`actual_distance_m` IS NULL OR `trip_facts`.`actual_distance_m` >= 0) AND (`trip_facts`.`measured_segment_m` IS NULL OR `trip_facts`.`measured_segment_m` >= 0) AND (`trip_facts`.`planned_distance_m` IS NULL OR `trip_facts`.`planned_distance_m` >= 0) AND (`trip_facts`.`delivered_distance_m` IS NULL OR `trip_facts`.`delivered_distance_m` >= 0) AND (`trip_facts`.`fuel_used_l` IS NULL OR `trip_facts`.`fuel_used_l` >= 0) AND (`trip_facts`.`cargo_damage_fraction` IS NULL OR (`trip_facts`.`cargo_damage_fraction` >= 0 AND `trip_facts`.`cargo_damage_fraction` <= 1))

manual_evidence_ready_shape.name: manual_evidence_ready_shape
manual_evidence_ready_shape.value: `manual_evidence`.`state` NOT IN ('ready','deleting','expired') OR (`manual_evidence`.`sha256` IS NOT NULL AND `manual_evidence`.`fingerprint` IS NOT NULL AND `manual_evidence`.`byte_length` > 0)

event_decline_reason.name: event_decline_reason
event_decline_reason.value: (`event_response_revisions`.`status`='declined' AND `event_response_revisions`.`reason` IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(`event_response_revisions`.`reason`))>0) OR (`event_response_revisions`.`status`<>'declined' AND `event_response_revisions`.`reason` IS NULL)

trip_proposal_event_shape.name: trip_proposal_event_shape
trip_proposal_event_shape.value: (`trip_proposals`.`event_id` IS NULL AND `trip_proposals`.`event_revision_id` IS NULL AND `trip_proposals`.`attendance_revision_id` IS NULL) OR (`trip_proposals`.`event_id` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_proposals`.`event_revision_id` IS NOT NULL)
